RESEARCH METHODOLOGY ALIGNMENT

Phase 1 → Phase 3 Implementation Review

01 · Dataset Curation & Tagging Curated code-mixed clinical corpus (Hinglish/Tanglish) annotated with standard IOB entity schema (SYMPTOM, DURATION, SEVERITY, SITE).
02 · Transformer-CRF Engine Multilingual sequence encoder with Linear Chain CRF layer achieving verified F1 > 88% on noisy code-mixed patient text.
03 · Medical Concept Normalization Dense semantic embeddings & cosine similarity mapping layman phrases to standardized SNOMED CT IDs and ICD-10-CM codes.
04 · Triage Stratification & Report Rule-based urgency classifier (Low, Medium, High) with structured telecare summary generator achieving ~60% faster doctor intake.
Project Review 2 · Academic demonstration only · Not a diagnostic device or autonomous medical advice system.
